content.text:
All tests pass. Here's the summary:

**Bug:** On re-run of `entire enable`, the pre-selection set was `installed agents + detected agents`. After deselecting Gemini CLI, hooks were properly removed, but the `.gemini/` directory still existed, so `DetectAll()` still found it and it got pre-selected again.

**Fix:** On re-run (`hasInstalledHooks=true`), only pre-select agents that have hooks installed. Detected-but-not-installed agents still appear as options — they're just not checked by default. On first run, the original behavior (pre-select all detected agents) is preserved.
